formulas.formula: Give every dollar a job before the month begins.
1. Budget Plan: type the year and your income for a normal month (each paycheck on its own line).
2. Still on Budget Plan: give every dollar a job. Add categories with a group and a Monthly Amount until 'Left to Assign' shows $0.
3. A month is different (a bonus, holiday gifts)? Type over that month's cell. Keep Left to Assign at $0.
4. Transactions: log every paycheck and every purchase with its category.
5. Month View: pick a month to see what's left in each category, plus envelope balances that roll over.
6. Year Summary and Dashboard: your whole year at a glance.
Income minus everything you assign = $0. It doesn't mean you spend it all: saving is a job too.
Money you don't spend in a category stays there for next month (the Rollover column).
Move money from another category on Budget Plan so the month still balances.
On Transactions, select columns B to G from row 6 down and press Delete.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: every dollar assigned, or money left in a category.
Yellow: money still to assign, or close to the limit.
Red: over-assigned, overspent, or something to check.
Thank you for your purchase! Every dollar with a job is a dollar working for you.
=IF(TRIM('Budget Plan'!C5&"")="","Your zero-based year at a glance.",'Budget Plan'!C5&"'s zero-based year at a glance.")

kpi_cards.label: ZERO-BASED CHECK
kpi_cards.value: =IF(ROUND(R6-R7,2)=0,"Every dollar has a job",IF(R6-R7>0,TEXT(R6-R7,"$#,##0.00")&" still to assign",TEXT(R7-R6,"$#,##0.00")&" over-assigned"))

formulas.formula: Pick a month. Remaining = assigned minus spent this month. Rollover = everything assigned minus everything spent so far this year (your envelope balance).
Plan a normal month in Monthly Amount: it fills January to December. Type over any month that's different. Aim for Left to Assign = $0 every month.
Every paycheck and every purchase, one row each. Pick the category (income lines are in the list too).
What you actually spent in every category, every month, against what you assigned.
